_comment: Pinned tool versions for Trendy Tools. Do NOT auto-update. Upgrade only by manually changing the ref/tag and rebuilding.

tools.name: BentoPDF
tools.description: Privacy-first browser PDF toolkit: merge, split, OCR, redact, sign, encrypt, compress, convert.
tools.build: pnpm install && sed -i 's/vite build/vite build --base=\/tools\/bentopdf\//g' package.json && pnpm run build

tools.name: IT-Tools
tools.description: Collection of handy online tools for developers: JSON, JWT, regex, UUID, hashing, timestamps, and more.
tools.build: pnpm install && sed -i 's/vite build/vite build --base=\/tools\/it-tools\//g' package.json && pnpm run build

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.description: The Cyber Swiss Army Knife: data transformation, encoding, encryption, compression, and analysis.

tools.name: Squoosh
tools.description: Image compression and format conversion, fully browser-side. Fast and polished.
tools.build: npm install && BASE_URL=/tools/squoosh/ npm run build (with static URL helper adapter)

tools.name: miniPaint
tools.description: Lightweight Photoshop-style browser editor with layers, filters, selections, transparency, and effects.
tools.build: npm install && PUBLIC_URL=/tools/minipaint/ npm run build

tools.name: FreeCut
tools.description: Browser-native non-linear video editor with multi-track editing, keyframes, masks, and audio tools.
tools.build: npm ci && node scripts/adapt-freecut.mjs && npm run build

tools.name: Omniclip
tools.description: Open-source browser-local video editor with modern browser media APIs.
tools.build: npm ci && node adapt-omniclip.mjs pre && npm run build-netlify && node adapt-omniclip.mjs post

tools.name: Excalidraw
tools.description: Quick diagrams, brainstorming, wireframes, architecture sketches. Local-first and widely used.
tools.build: Node 22: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && node adapt-excalidraw.mjs && yarn build:app:docker

tools.name: D2 Playground
tools.description: Architecture and technical diagrams from plain text. Git-friendly, AI-friendly.
tools.build: yarn --cwd src/js install --frozen-lockfile && esbuild 0.16.3 official static pipeline

tools.name: JupyterLite
tools.description: Full Jupyter notebook environment running Python in the browser via WebAssembly.
tools.build: pip install jupyterlite-core jupyterlite-pyodide-kernel && jupyter lite build --base-url /tools/jupyterlite/ --output-dir _output

tools.name: DuckDB-Wasm
tools.description: Analyze CSV, JSON, and Parquet locally using SQL. No database installation needed.
tools.build: npm install && PUBLIC_URL=/tools/duckdb-wasm/ npm run build

tools.name: OpenQR
tools.description: Full-featured QR generator: URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts, locations, messaging, styling, and export.
tools.build: pnpm install && sed -i 's|basePath: ""|basePath: "/tools/openqr"|g' next.config.mjs 2>/dev/null || true && pnpm build

tools.name: Decimen
tools.description: Transfer files via animated QR codes. Works across air-gapped devices -- screen to camera.
tools.build: npm install && sed -i 's/vite build/vite build --base=\/tools\/decimen\//g' package.json && npm run build

tools.name: KeeWeb
tools.description: Browser-accessible KeePass/KDBX password manager with local vault support.

tools.name: WebLLM
tools.description: Run open LLMs directly in the browser via WebGPU. Private local inference.
tools.build: npm install && sed -i 's/vite build/vite build --base=\/tools\/web-llm\//g' package.json && npm run build

tools.name: Bolo
tools.description: Browser-native screen, webcam, and mic recorder with local Whisper transcription.
tools.build: Single HTML file -- no build required. Copy index.html.
